meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 GitHub 拉取请求的代码改动变成一段讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队要把每次代码改动讲给不懂代码的人听
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub pull request into a narrated code-change explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must explain code changes to non-technical teammates.

howto.what: 给它一个 GitHub PR(链接、owner/repo#N,或已检出仓库里的「这个 PR」),Claude 会读取 diff、提交和文件,逐帧生成讲解这次代码改动的视频,最终渲染出 renders/video.mp4,风格固定为 code-editorial。
howto.when: 当你给出一个 GitHub PR(链接、owner/repo#N 或已检出仓库里的「这个 PR」)时接管;输入是代码改动,不是网站。产品宣传或无 PR 的话题讲解另有技能。

say.text: 用 owner/repo#1842 生成一个修复讲解视频,长度短一点
say.note: 长度由 PR 大小在简报里定

say.text: 这个 PR 视频换一个男声旁白
say.note: 音频步骤用 --voice 指定音色

howto.what_en: Give it a GitHub pull request (a URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo); Claude reads the diff, commits and files to build a frame-by-frame code-change explainer video, ending in renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you hand it a GitHub pull request; the input is a code change, not a website. Product promos or PR-less topic explainers go to other skills.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a video: https://github.com/acme/sdk/pull/1842
say_en.note: Runs setup, writes hyperframes.json and BRIEF.md

say_en.text: Make a fix-explainer video for owner/repo#1842, keep it short
say_en.note: Length comes from PR size in the brief

say_en.text: Use a male voice for this PR video
